title: scabiosa simplex subsp. dentata
intro: Scabiosa simplex subsp. dentata, commonly known as pincushion flower, is a plant species within the scabiosa genus and is known for its unique, pincushion-like flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of scabiosa simplex subsp. dentata include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
